signals.title: Training signals
signals.intro: Four measures from your logged workouts, {recent} beside {previous}. They state what changed, not why.
signals.rule: A measure is marked when average RPE rises {rpeRise} or more, the share of sets short of their rep target rises {shortPointsRise} points (at least {minShortSets}), a lift's best estimated 1RM falls in each of its last {falls} sessions by {minDecline}% in total, or you trained at least {workoutDrop} fewer times or ended more workouts early. Deload workouts count only as workouts.
signals.effortNeedMore: Log RPE on at least {min} sets of the same lifts in both periods to compare. So far: {recentSets} in {recent}, {previousSets} in {previous}.
signals.effort: Average RPE {recentRpe} over {recentSets} in {recent}, {previousRpe} over {previousSets} in {previous}, {change}. Counted on the {lifts} you logged with RPE in both.
signals.repTargetsNoneRecent: No sets had a rep target in {recent}
signals.repTargetsRecent: {short} of {sets} fell short of their rep target in {recent} ({percent}%)
signals.repTargetsNotComparable: Comparing needs at least {min} sets with a rep target in each period.
signals.decline: Best estimated 1RM {values} {unit} on {dates}, down {percent}% over its last {sessions} sessions.
signals.noDeclinesNoLifts: No lift has {sessions} sessions in the last {days} days to compare.
signals.noDeclines: No lift's best estimated 1RM fell in each of its last {sessions} sessions.
signals.introFallback: Measures from your logged workouts over the last four weeks.
signals.unavailableBody: We could not read your recent workouts. Try again.

volume.note: Volume is external load × repetitions, so it is a workload signal, not a strength score. Bodyweight sets remain in the set count but add zero load volume. Muscle volume uses the same 1.0 primary / 0.5 secondary weighting as the distribution map; the current week is partial.
